# Certificates of Quality — Purely Plant DOOEL
### Intermediate bulk · dry cannabis flower for medical use · 21.09.2026

172 certificates of quality and 172 internal certificates of analysis, one to one.
One A4 page each, fonts embedded, no draft stamp, Section 04 conformity decision ticked.

**This is the SIGNED set.** The deposited signatures of the QA Manager and the Head of QC
are applied to every page; the Analyst box keeps its line and is signed by hand. The desk
issues the same fleet twice (Head of QC, 18.09.2026) — *"one complete set with the
signatures applied and one complete set without"* — and one switch drives the whole
pipeline, `PP_SIGNATURES=1`, which also names the archives, so the two sets sit side by
side in this folder and neither can be mistaken for the other.

An HTML certificate is self-contained and opens in any browser; a Word document carries the
certificate as the page exactly as it prints (not editable text). Every page of the merged
documents is bookmarked with its certificate code and P lot. All PDFs are **vector** — fonts
embedded, gradients opaque, no blend modes — prepared for a laser printer. Print at A4,
actual size, no scaling.

## How to read a result cell

The owner, 21.09.2026: *"There will be no empty space in the certificate of quality nor the
certificate of analysis — all parameter results must be filled in."* The design system says
the same thing in its own words: **absence of evidence is stated, never implied by a blank.**
Every result cell on all 172 certificates carries one of a closed set of eight tokens or a
figure with its unit. No cell is empty — verified, 4,674 of 4,674.

The RESULT column of Section 02 is a single ink, dark navy `#1B3A5C`. No colour marks an
edge case: a result is read against the `ACC. CRITERIA` column beside it, and the conformity
decision is in Section 04.

| token | what it asserts |
| --- | --- |
| `Conforms` · `Absent` | the determination was made and meets its criterion |
| `Does not conform` | the determination was made and does not |
| a figure with its unit | the measured result |
| `ND` · `< LOQ` | below the method's detection or quantitation limit |
| `n/t` | **not tested** — the determination was not performed in that round |
| `[ — ]` | no certificate on file covers this determination |
| `[pending]` | tested, result not yet issued |

**The one expected block of `n/t`.** Aflatoxin B₁ (#10.1) and Ochratoxin A (#10.3) print
`n/t` on the **initial** certificates — 88 each, 176 cells — because the release round ran
one sub-parameter and the re-analysis campaign ran the whole panel. That is the owner's own
account of it, and the retest certificates carry the full mycotoxin panel.

## What is still outstanding

**272 cells over 40 certificates** print `[ — ]` beyond that exception: determinations for
which no document exists in any record the desk holds. They are set out certificate by
certificate in `07_Records/SWEEP_AND_SIGNED_PRINT_2026-09-21.md`.

Two of those rows are one line from the laboratory rather than a gap in testing:

* **OI-63 · `75/0118/26`** prints its bile-tolerant count as `< 10³ и 10² CFU/g`, with no
  `>`. As printed the range asserts nothing, and a panel prints whole or not at all, so
  CoQ-PP_26-046 (WED102501) still states that no certificate covers #9.1–#9.5.
* **OI-64 · `434/0848/26`** names *Gorilla Glue* on its sample line and *Серија: FB032601*
  two lines below. Both lots exist; `433/0847/26` already covers FB032601 with different
  counts. CoQ-PP_26-082 (GG032601) is the one of the pair with an empty panel, and nothing
  is applied to either until the Institute says which lot the page certifies.

Every open question the desk cannot settle itself is in `07_Records/OPEN_ITEMS.md` — 46 open,
3 marked on the certificate.
